from unittest import TestCase import mistune class TestAutoseIssue18E2E(TestCase): def test_url_plugin_acceptance_criteria(self): # AC-FR-001-1 self.assertEqual( mistune.html("visit www.example.com/docs", plugins=["url"]), '

visit www.example.com/docs

\n', ) # AC-FR-002-1 self.assertEqual( mistune.html("visit https://example.com/old", plugins=["url"]), '

visit https://example.com/old

\n', ) # AC-FR-003-1 self.assertEqual( mistune.html("www.example.com", plugins=["url"]), '

www.example.com

\n', ) # AC-FR-004-1 self.assertEqual( mistune.html("not a link: my_www.example", plugins=["url"]), '

not a link: my_www.example

\n', ) def test_url_plugin_combined_with_plugins_and_options(self): md = mistune.create_markdown( plugins=["url", "table", "task_lists"], hard_wrap=True, escape=False, ) text = ( "Check out www.example.com and https://example.org.\n" "Line two after hard wrap.\n\n" "- [x] Task with link www.task.org/item\n\n" "| Header | URL |\n" "| --- | --- |\n" "| Site | www.table.net |\n" ) result = md(text) self.assertIn('www.example.com', result) self.assertIn('https://example.org', result) self.assertIn('www.task.org/item', result) self.assertIn('www.table.net', result) self.assertIn('
', result) self.assertIn('checked=""', result) self.assertIn('', result) def test_regression_standard_markdown_links(self): # Regression test for standard markdown links [text](url) and reference links text = "Visit [Example](https://example.com) or [Ref][ref].\n\n[ref]: https://ref.example.com\n" result1 = mistune.html(text, plugins=["url"]) result2 = mistune.html(text) expected = ( '

Visit Example or ' 'Ref.

\n' ) self.assertEqual(result1, expected) self.assertEqual(result2, expected) def test_regression_autolinks_and_code_spans(self): # Regression test for angle-bracket autolinks and code spans containing www. or http:// text = "Autolink and code `www.example.com` and `http://example.com`." result = mistune.html(text, plugins=["url"]) self.assertIn('https://example.com', result) self.assertIn('www.example.com', result) self.assertIn('http://example.com', result) def test_regression_emphasis_and_formatting(self): # Regression test for markdown emphasis and formatting near URLs text = "Visit **www.bold-site.com** and *https://italic-site.org* with ~~www.strike.net~~." result = mistune.html(text, plugins=["url", "strikethrough"]) self.assertIn('www.bold-site.com', result) self.assertIn('https://italic-site.org', result) self.assertIn('www.strike.net', result)
